remarks: **Receive up to one month free when you lease in May** Gorgeous one-bedroom apartment on Main Street in a landmark, boutique building (one of only ten units). Located in the heart of New Canaan Village, it is ideal for a highly walkable lifestyle with easy access to shops, restaurants, and the train for a Grand Central commute. The residence blends old-world charm (1881) with luxury new construction (2023 renovation). Features include high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a modern, open-concept kitchen with new appliances (range, dishwasher, refrigerator). Enjoy new windows, a separate heating/cooling system with your own thermostat, and a spectacular common roof deck with seating and chaise lounges.
